messages:
Arjun K.: Quick sync — Greenleaf Systems asked for a limited EAP: on-prem H100 cluster + cloud g5 parity for a marketplace pilot. They want NDA, bench results, and a go/no-go by end of month. Who's in?
Nia L.: I can own the bench harness and sanity tests. what's the cluster spec?
Greenleaf_Partner: We'll provide 6x H100 (60GB) in our lab and 3 g5 instances in cloud for parity. Access via partner jumpbox. NDA needs to be signed before SSH creds.
Carlos V.: Noted. SRE: we'll need a short telemetry shim + node health exporter. Also recommend a driver & cuda validation step first.
Priya S.: Marketing: early marketplace listing needs approved blurb, partner logo, and embargo window. tentative announce slot 2 weeks after go.
Arjun K.: LegalBot, can you push the NDA? We need to review SSO addendum and co-marketing clause.
LegalBot: NDA draft (Greenleaf_EAP_v1) uploaded at https://legal.redwood.example/nda/greenleaf/v1. Please review; partner requested 7-day review turnaround.
Nia L.: Bench scope proposal: 1) perf sweep (seq 512/1024/2048), batch 1/4/8; 2) mem/peak and NVidia-smi traces; 3) KV-cache stress run (long context warmup). We'll log OOMs and tail latency.
Carlos V.: Add prometheus labels: `host`, `gpu_model`, `driver_version`, `seq_len`. I'll stand up a small grafana dashboard for the run.
Priya S.: For listing: we'll need partner copy, 2 logos (svg/png), and an embargoed 1-paragraph joint blurb. Greenleaf requires co-review 48h before publish.
Greenleaf_Partner: ack on co-review. we'll also want a short joint benchmark chart in the marketplace tile (non-confidential).
Arjun K.: Risk flags: partner lab has mixed driver versions on 2 nodes — Nia, please run a driver_check.sh before runs. Also ensure SSH key rotation is possible.
Nia L.: Will do. driver_check.sh will detect `nvidia-smi` output, cuda-runtime, and docker driver compatibility. I'll publish script to the bench repo.
Carlos V.: Rollback plan idea: if cloud g5 p50 latency >25% of H100 baseline, route traffic to smaller quant model and open a priority incident to partner liaison.
Priya S.: Timeline ask: NDA signed by 03/28, bench runs 03/29-04/02, partner review 04/04, tentative marketplace freeze 04/06. Are these dates okay?
Arjun K.: Tight but doable. Legal must hit 03/28 or we'll slip.
LegalBot: Flag: co-marketing clause asks for mutual review. Suggest we approve copy internally by 04/01 to hit 04/04.
Nia L.: I'll start the bench harness tomorrow and drop a link to the repo. Basic run command: `python bench/run.py --model redwood-v2 --batch 4 --seq 1024 --collect-metrics`
Carlos V.: Provisioning ticket created: PROV-7822 for jumpbox + prometheus endpoint.
Priya S.: I'll draft the embargo blurb and circulate. Greenleaf, who on your side will be the marketing reviewer?
Greenleaf_Partner: Emily (emily.greenleaf) will be reviewer. She prefers Slack DMs for quick approvals.
Arjun K.: Action items: Arjun (owner) - coordinate NDA & keys by 03/28; Nia - bench harness + driver_check by 03/27; Carlos - telemetry + dashboard by 03/29; Priya - draft blurb + assets request by 03/30. Update here with any blockers.
Nia L.: Repo created: https://git.internal/bench/greenleaf-eap (invite sent).
Carlos V.: I'll push a starter dashboard and `/metrics/eap` endpoint stub.
LegalBot: Reminder: NDA comments due 03/26 to keep 03/28 signature target.
Priya S.: Scheduling partner sync for 03/30 to walk through bench plan and launch checklist.
Arjun K.: Great. Keeping this thread for coordination. If anything urgent, ping me or escalate to partnerships@redwood. :white_check_mark:
